requirements.text: PRODUCER MODEL — Writing producers for D-045 campaign tasks run exact model id claude-sonnet-5 (never an alias). This is the owner-authorized settings change to the producer agent files; apply from the next dispatch. D-004 (R734–R742) is superseded ONLY for producer-agent model keys.
requirements.required_harness: producer agent files carry model claude-sonnet-5; dispatch records show it
requirements.required_evidence: settings diff + subsequent campaign dispatches on claude-sonnet-5

requirements.text: REVIEWER / ORCHESTRATOR PRESERVATION — Gate reviewers and the orchestrator are UNCHANGED: the D-004 pinned claude-fable-5 six-file set and the standing Fable→claude-opus-4-8 xhigh reviewer-fallback rule stay exactly as previously owner-decided. This directive changes no reviewer or orchestrator model key. The owner explicitly selected 'Builders only' over 'Builders + reviewers'.
requirements.required_harness: reviewer/orchestrator agent files byte-unchanged in their model keys
requirements.required_evidence: no reviewer/orchestrator model change cites D-047

requirements.text: ESCALATION RULE — A campaign task whose Sonnet-built material fails independent review twice is rebuilt with a claude-opus-4-8 producer (part of the owner-selected option text). The rework routing is recorded in the task's progress log.
requirements.required_harness: progress log shows model escalation on second review failure
requirements.required_evidence: any twice-failed task's rebuild dispatched on claude-opus-4-8

requirements.text: CONCURRENCY CEILING 10, RAMPED — Supersedes the numeric ceiling in D-046-R001/R004 (was 3): up to 10 concurrent writing producers, with a MANDATORY RAMP — start at 3–4 and widen only while review latency and CI throughput stay healthy; back off under resource pressure per D-046-R004. Everything else in D-046 (R002 disjointness, R003 no quality relaxation, quiet monitoring) remains fully in force. The owner's '10 20' was resolved to 10 by explicit selection; 20 was offered and not chosen.
requirements.required_harness: dispatch width never exceeds 10; ramp visible in dispatch record
requirements.required_evidence: no wave dispatched >10 producers; widening correlated with healthy review/CI latency

requirements.text: RELAY / ACKNOWLEDGMENT (return item) — The companion session relays this directive to the live build session; the build session acknowledges, applies the producer-model settings change, and runs subsequent waves under the ramped ceiling. Discharged when acknowledged and the first Sonnet-producer dispatch is recorded.
requirements.required_harness: cross-session message + acknowledgment; first claude-sonnet-5 dispatch recorded
requirements.required_evidence: message in this capture's audit_log; subsequent dispatch record
